JIOFIN.NS.d: Jio Financial Services Limited offers digital financial products and services as a non-banking financial company in India, and it does not take deposits. Based in Mumbai and set up in 1999, it was formerly Reliance Strategic Investments Limited and took its present name in July 2023.

KEC.NS.d: KEC International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) business. It designs, manufactures, tests, supplies, and erects transmission lines on turnkey basis; and undertakes EPC projects of high voltage electrical switching and distribution substations, distribution network, optical fiber networks, telecom towers, and HV and EHV cabling project works.

KOVAI.NS.d: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited is a Coimbatore-based company, founded in 1985, that provides hospital and educational services through healthcare and education divisions. Its healthcare facilities cover a wide range of specialties, including critical care, emergency medicine, cardiology through a Heart Institute, neurology, nephrology, gastroenterology and obstetrics.

LOTUSDEV.NS.d: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited, based in Mumbai and established in 2003, develops residential and commercial property, focusing on premium redevelopment projects in the luxury and ultra-luxury segments in Mumbai's western suburbs. It was formerly AKP Holdings Limited and took its present name in December.

MAFATIND.NS.d: Mafatlal Industries Limited is a textile manufacturer involved in producing yarn, fabrics, and garments. The company caters to both domestic and international markets. The company is based in India.

MKPL.NS.d: M. K. Proteins Limited produces and trades refined vegetable oils and derivatives, including rice bran, sunflower, cottonseed, soybean, palm and canola oils. It also sells by-products such as rice bran fatty acid oils, waxes, gums and spent earth, and imports and trades edible and non-edible oils. Founded in 2012, it is headquartered in Ambala.

MOBIKWIK.NS.d: One Mobikwik Systems Limited is a mobile fintech company with three divisions: Buy Now Pay Later, Consumer Payments and Payment Gateway. BNPL offers small-value credit mainly to middle-class customers, Consumer Payments runs the MobiKwik Wallet app and its merchant network, and the Zaakpay brand operates as a payment gateway aggregator.

NIRMAN.NS.d: Nirman Agri Genetics Ltd. is an Indian agri-input company primarily focused on the production, processing, and marketing of high-quality hybrid seeds. The company's product portfolio includes hybrid seeds for various field crops such as maize, paddy, bajra, sunflower, corn, and cotton, as well as vegetables like tomato, chili, okra, bitter gourd, cabbage, and capsicum. They also produce non-hybrid seeds, mainly for paddy.

OAL.NS.d: Oriental Aromatics Limited manufactures and sells terpene chemicals, camphor, and other specialty aroma chemicals in India and internationally. It offers sandalwood derivates, including mysornaol, durganol, shivanol, and shaktinol; and pinene derivatives, which include alpha pinene epoxide, alpha campholenic aldehyde, camphor GF, isobornyl acetate, isoborneol, terpineol, and terpinyl acetate.

OMFURN.NS.d: Omfurn India Ltd. manufactures and supplies modular furniture and pre-finished wooden doors. The company offers a range of products including office, hotel, and school furniture, as well as modular kitchens, wardrobes, and vanities. It also provides pre-finished wooden doors, door frames, and fire-resistant doors. Omfurn India Ltd. specializes in turnkey interior projects, offering integrated services from design to installation.

PAR-SM.NS.d: PAR DRUGS AND CHEM is involved in the manufacturing and distribution of pharmaceuticals and chemicals. The company focuses on supplying to various industries. The company is based in India.

PILANIINVS.NS.d: Pilani Investment and Industries Corporation Limited, a non-banking financial company, invests in group companies and mutual funds in India. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in Kolkata, India.

PRECAM.NS.d: Precision Camshafts Limited manufactures and sells parts of motor vehicle for original equipment manufacturers in India, Asia, China, Europe, and internationally.

RELCAPITAL.NS.d: Reliance Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, primarily engages in lending and investing activities in India. It operates through Finance & Investment, General Insurance, Life Insurance, Commercial Finance, Home Finance, and Others segments.

SALSTEEL.NS.d: S.A.L. Steel Limited manufactures and sells sponge iron and ferro alloys in India and internationally. It operates through Iron & Steel and Power segments. The company also offers iron ore pellets and finished steel products. Its products are primarily used in iron and steel industries. In addition, it generates and sells 40 MW power from waste heat recovery boiler and fluidized bed combustion boiler. S.A.L. Steel Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.

SANGHVIFOR.NS.d: Sanghvi Forging & Engineering Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of open and closed die forging products in India. The company offers heavy forging products, such as forged bars, shaft and step shafts, tube sheets, shell forgings, forged pipes and hollow shaft forgings, rings, die blocks and rounds, BOP and valve bodies, and heavy machine products. It also provides forged flanges and components, including forged and open die flanges, instrument and ball forgings, and components.

SGL.NS.d: STL Global Limited manufactures and sells textile products in India. It is involved in knitting, dyeing and processing, yarn dyeing, woven processing, thread sewing, and readymade garments manufacturing businesses. The company also produces and exports men's wear, women's tops, boys and girls wear, kids and infants wear, and knitted and woven bed sheets to the United States, the European Union, Canada, and internationally. In addition, it engages in real estate business.

SKYGOLD.NS.d: Sky Gold Limited, set up in 2008, with its head office in Mumbai, handles the full lifecycle of gold and silver jewellery in India, from design through manufacturing, assembly, cutting, polishing, marketing and sales. Its products include bangles, earrings, bracelets, pendants, rings and necklaces, and it makes jewellery to order.

SRPL.NS.d: Shree Ram Proteins Limited engages in pressing and crushing of cotton seeds in India. Its products include cotton linter, seed meal, seed hull, seed wash oil, and seed refine oil; and soybean meal, rapeseed meal, groundnut meal, and raw cotton bales. The company also exports its products. Shree Ram Proteins Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Rajkot, India.

SRTL.NS.d: Shree Ram Twistex Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SRTL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SRTRANSFIN-ZD.NS.d: Sec Red NCD 8.52% Sr.I represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, offering a fixed interest rate of 8.52% and belonging to Series I of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

TCPLPACK.NS.d: TCPL Packaging Limited manufactures and sells packaging products in India. It offers folding cartons, printed blanks and outers, litho-lamination products, plastic cartons, blister packs, and shelf-ready packaging products, as well as printed cork-tipping papers, laminates, sleeves, and wrap-around labels. The company also exports its products. It serves the tobacco, FMCG, food and beverage, liquor, pharmaceuticals, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Twenty-First Century Printers Ltd.

TRANSRAILL.NS.d: Transrail Lighting Ltd. is an EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) company that designs, produces, inspects, erects and delivers galvanised steel components and electrical conductors used in power transmission and distribution networks, in India and worldwide. It also undertakes civil and other projects outside the power sector.

VMARCIND.NS.d: V-Marc India Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer and marketer of a diverse range of wires and cables, operating primarily within the electrical equipment industry. The company's core products include single-core and multi-core cables, low and high voltage power cables, control cables, communication cables such as LAN, CCTV, coaxial, and telephone cables, as well as flat cables and solar cables.

WORTHPERI.NS.d: Worth Peripherals Limited is an Indian company that makes and supplies corrugated boxes and sheets. Its range includes multi-colour corrugated packaging, boxes and trays that are custom die-cut, regular slotted containers, and internal dividers such as Z sleeves and honeycomb partitions.
